title: CreaTrace: Video Creative Plagiarism Detection and Evidence Tracing
abstract: arXiv:2611.19976v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Video creative plagiarism refers to the unauthorized reproduction of creative ideas across videos despite substantial differences in visual appearance, posing a new challenge to video copyright protection. However, existing video copy detection methods primarily focus on visual content similarity, struggling to capture abstract creative that are entangled with specific visual realizations. To address this issue, we introduce a novel task, named Video Creative Plagiarism Detection (VCPD), and propose an iterative creative evidence tracing framework, termed CreaTrace, to verify creative similarity and accurately localize the corresponding evidence segments. Specifically, we design a Multimodal Semantic Event Segmentation strategy to divide similar long videos into coherent narrative events, facilitating event-level dataset construction and retrieving similar segments. translated_title: CreaTrace：视频创意抄袭检测与证据追踪
translated_abstract: 视频创意抄袭是指尽管视频在视觉外观上存在显著差异，创意思想仍被未经授权地复制再现的现象，这对视频版权保护构成了新的挑战。然而，现有的视频拷贝检测方法主要关注视觉内容的相似性，难以捕捉与特定视觉实现相纠缠的抽象创意。为了解决这一问题，我们引入了一个名为视频创意抄袭检测（VCPD）的新任务，并提出了一种迭代的创意证据追踪框架 CreaTrace，用于验证创意相似性并准确定位相应的证据片段。具体而言，我们设计了一种多模态语义事件分割策略，将相似的长视频划分为连贯的叙事事件，从而促进事件级数据集的构建和相似片段的检索。基于这些事件，CreaTrace 采用粗粒度创意匹配来……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了视频创意抄袭检测（VCPD）这一新任务，并设计了迭代式创意证据追踪框架 CreaTrace，通过多模态语义事件分割与创意匹配，实现视频间创意相似性的验证与证据片段的准确定位。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the novel task of Video Creative Plagiarism Detection (VCPD) and proposes CreaTrace, an iterative creative evidence tracing framework that verifies creative similarity and accurately localizes evidence segments through multimodal semantic event segmentation and creative matching.
